title: Half-hour repair
body: The plank receipt is stapled to a note asking everyone to stay outside until the treated boards dry. A radio call time is written beside “half hour.”
rival_reading: A response crew could have treated or disinfected boards during containment; the timing does not establish a crop program.
gloss: A household waits outside after treated boards are installed and a radio check is scheduled.

cites.quote: barricade with the planks I brought you
